Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_09019_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_09019_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_09019 (
   input                 clk_i           ,  
   input                 rstn_i          ,  
   output reg [23:0]     dac_a_o         ,  
   output reg [23:0]     dac_b_o         ,  
   output reg [23:0]     dac_c_o         ,  
   output reg [23:0]     dac_d_o         ,  
   input      [31:0]     sys_addr        ,  
   input      [31:0]     sys_wdata       ,  
   input      [3:0]      sys_sel         ,  
   input                 sys_wen         ,  
   input                 sys_ren         ,  
   output reg [31:0]     sys_rdata       ,  
   output reg            sys_err         ,  
   output reg            sys_ack            
);

always @(posedge clk_i)
if (rstn_i == 1'b0) begin
   dac_a_o     <= 24'h0F_0000;
   dac_b_o     <= 24'h4E_0000;
   dac_c_o     <= 24'h75_0000;
   dac_d_o     <= 24'h9C_0000;
end else begin
   if (sys_wen) begin
      if (sys_addr[19:0] == 20'h00020)   dac_a_o <= sys_wdata[23:0] ;
      if (sys_addr[19:0] == 20'h00024)   dac_b_o <= sys_wdata[23:0] ;
      if (sys_addr[19:0] == 20'h00028)   dac_c_o <= sys_wdata[23:0] ;
      if (sys_addr[19:0] == 20'h0002C)   dac_d_o <= sys_wdata[23:0] ;
   end
end

wire sys_en;
assign sys_en = sys_wen | sys_ren;

always @(posedge clk_i)
if (rstn_i == 1'b0) begin
   sys_err <= 1'b0 ;
   sys_ack <= 1'b0 ;
end else begin
   sys_err <= 1'b0 ;
   casez (sys_addr[19:0])
     20'h00020 : begin sys_ack <= sys_en; sys_rdata <= {8'd0, dac_a_o}; end
     20'h00024 : begin sys_ack <= sys_en; sys_rdata <= {8'd0, dac_b_o}; end
     20'h00028 : begin sys_ack <= sys_en; sys_rdata <= {8'd0, dac_c_o}; end
     20'h0002C : begin sys_ack <= sys_en; sys_rdata <= {8'd0, dac_d_o}; end
       default : begin sys_ack <= sys_en; sys_rdata <= 32'd0; end
   endcase
end

endmodule
